title.en: An Act Creating Four Additional Positions of Assistant Provincial Fiscal for the Province of Davao Oriental, Amending for the Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended
title.orig: An Act Creating Four Additional Positions of Assistant Provincial Fiscal for the Province of Davao Oriental, Amending for the Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6242_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Davao Oriental, is further amended to read as follows:
"Davao Oriental, six assistant provincial fiscals;"

There is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of forty thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary to pay the share of the National Government for the positions provided for in this Act for the current fiscal year. Thereafter, appropriate for the succeeding fiscal years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
